turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

*Meredith steps in, doesn't sit. Checks her watch.*

Mr. Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother.

I have twenty minutes. I have a client call after this.

You entered a zero before you called me. I'd like to know why.

And I'd like to know what that zero is based on. Specifically. What did you look at, and when?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.

*She finally sits. Doesn't take her coat off.*

Good. Then there's a record.

When did you speak? What time? Was anything written down?

And what did the vice principal decide? Or did she only listen?

I'm not asking for an opinion. I'm asking what happened, and when.

One more thing. Has anyone said a word about this to Owen's class? Anyone at all?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

*She doesn't blink.*

"Backing you" isn't a document.

Policy is policy. Fine. Which one? Give me the title, the section, and the date it was adopted.

Does it say a detector score alone is enough for a zero? Yes or no.

I'd also like the report itself. The 94%. Which tool, what version, what day you ran it.

And you haven't answered my other question. Has Owen's class been told anything?

I'm not here to argue about who's in charge. I'm here to see what you actually have.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

*She sets her phone face down on the desk.*

A courtesy. Noted.

Then I'll be courteous and brief.

Claire. Four years ago. Same school, same kind of zero. She won on appeal. Too late for her scholarship. I have the dates. I have the file.

So I know how this goes. The zero stays while the appeal runs. The damage is done before anyone's right.

I'm not asking for a favour. I'm asking what process exists, in writing, and where Owen's work is in it.

Is the zero on his record now? Or only in your gradebook?

And Owen. Nobody says a word to that class. Can you tell me that?
